_kat_input.$comment: Real P-256-signed envelope (RFC-AITP-0001 §5.4). The envelope is exactly env-005's input envelope with its __VALID_ENVELOPE_SIG__ placeholder replaced by a committed signature; scripts/verify-known-answer.mjs asserts the two agree member for member apart from `signature`. sig_input_v2 is the 16 ASCII bytes "aitp-envelope-v2", one 0x00 byte, then JCS(envelope without `signature`); d = sha256(sig_input_v2); the p256 signature is ECDSA with e = d (§5.4.6), RFC 6979 deterministic k, low-S (§5.4.7).

_must_not_verify.$comment: Neither value verifies over sig_input_v2. double_hash_signature is ECDSA over sha256(d) instead of d: what a signer that hashes the digest again emits. v1_signature is this vector's value before issue #87: a valid signature over the retired pipe-composed input v1_sig_input (message_id|timestamp|sender.agent_id|hex(sha256(JCS(payload)))), which covers neither version, message_type nor extensions.
